title: Heaven's Mandate Son
next_chapter_hook: The news spread like wildfire across the entire Cultivation World—that the servant disciple deemed as waste had actually become the Heaven's Mandate Son? The undercurrents of various forces stirred quietly at this moment.

text.content: In that moment, Chen Ji felt something observing his soul. The Heavenly Eye—that legendary existence—was actually descending at this time. Strangely, he felt no fear. Master Mo's urgent voice rang in his mind: 'Steady! It's testing you—don't show any flaws now!' Chen Ji took a deep breath, his expression unchanged, as if that suffocating pressure had merely been an illusion. Ling Yuan also sensed the anomaly immediately, but when his gaze fell upon Chen Ji, the latter was lowering his head, looking thoroughly terrified—a perfect image of a cowardlytrash.

dialogue.content: 'Don't panic. The Heavenly Eye is merely confirming your identity. It won't act against you yet—at least not until it confirms you're a controllable piece.' Master Mo's voice resonated in Chen Ji's consciousness, carrying a grave tone. '恰好，天青宗的选拔要开始了。'

text.content: Heaven's Mandate Son Selection. This was the grand event held once every thirty years by the Tianqing Sect, aimed at selecting young talents to bear the Heavenly Mandate. The victor would not only receive the sect's top-tier resource倾斜, but would also be sent to higher-level powers—as a candidate for the earthly representative of the Heavenly Chess Game. Master Mo told Chen Ji that this was precisely an opportunity to access higher-level secrets.

dialogue.content: 'Interesting.' A slight smile curved Chen Ji's lips. 'Since the Heavenly Eye wants to watch a show, I'll perform one for it.'

text.content: On the day of the selection, the Tianqing Sect Martial Arena was packed with people. On the high platform, Ling Yuan sat in the main seat, his gaze sweeping over the competing disciples like a hawk. Beside him were several sect elders, and—an unfamiliar middle-aged man in black robes. That robed figure's aura was terribly restrained; when Chen Ji probed lightly with the Tianji Record, he sensed absolutely nothing. Master Mo's voice rang out again: 'That's an observer of the Heavenly Eye. Be careful.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji gave a slight nod, then suppressed his aura to its lowest, strutting into the line of competing disciples. He deliberately walked very slowly, stumbling occasionally—a perfect image of atrash with unstable foundations. The surrounding disciples cast contemptuous glances, yet he paid no attention whatsoever.

text.content: 'Look, that's the rumoredtrash Chen Ji, actually daring to participate in the Heaven's Mandate Son selection?' 'Ha, he probably won't survive the first round!' The mocking voices rose one after another. Chen Ji heard nothing, but his gaze secretly swept across the robed figure as he silently calculated something. Master Mo had said the true meaning of Heaven's Mandate Son was a participant in the Heavenly Chess Game—he wanted to see what this chess game truly was.

dialogue.content: 'This Heaven's Mandate Son selection's rules are simple—hundred-person free-for-all, the final five standing gain qualification.' Ling Yuan's voice resonated across the entire arena. 'But the old man has added one condition: if any servant disciple can break into the top ten, reward of one thousand spirit stones.' This declaration stirred the entire crowd. Ling Yuan's lips carried a playful smile, clearly wanting to make a fool of Chen Ji.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan publicly mocked—this is a perfect opportunity to slap his face, but being too flamboyant might alert the Heavenly Eye's observer. How will you respond?

choices.description: Endure this breath, continue playing thetrash persona, let them enjoy their smugness for now.
choices.risk_hint: Might make readers think the protagonist is too cowardly

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his brows obediently, thanking him as if truly just atrash chasing the reward. Ling Yuansneered一声, turned to exchange whispers with the robed figure. No one noticed that in Chen Ji's lowered eyes, cold light was flickering. 'Good,' he silently念叨, 'let them laugh. The happier they laugh now, the louder the slap will be when the time comes.'

choices.description: Slightly display strength, let them knowtrash can also win, but still retain trump cards.

text.content: After the selection began, Chen Ji deliberately allowed himself to be 'accidentally' bumped by a core disciple. That disciple's name was Zhou Tong, always taking pleasure in bullying Chen Ji; now seeing thetrash deliver himself, he coldly laughed and slapped forward. Yet Chen Ji's form swayed slightly, casually deflecting eight成 of his strength. The counter-shock sent Zhou Tong stumbling back three steps. 'trash, you—' 'Zhou Senior Brother, you've been too courteous.' Chen Ji clasped his hands, expression utterly innocent. The surrounding disciples exchanged confused glances—when did thistrash have such skill?

choices.description: Since we're going to slap faces, do it thoroughly! Let everyone witness what a true genius looks like!
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye Observer Will Focus on You

text.content: The moment the hundred-disciple melees began, Chen Ji burst forth like a tiger escaping its cage. He no longer concealed anything, unleashing his full ten-tenths cultivation. Wherever his palm wind passed, disciples flew backward like straw. Within five breaths, five core disciples lay fallen and unable to rise. Complete silence descended upon the arena. Ling Yuan's expression instantly turned gloomy, while the black-robed figure's gaze fell upon Chen Ji for the first time with proper attention. 'Interesting,' the black-robed figure murmured. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in Chen Ji's mind, carrying a hint of warning: 'Well done, but you've already been marked.'

The selection continued, and regardless of which strategy Chen Ji employed, the battle remained under his control. Meanwhile, the black-robed observer was recording everything with a peculiar jade slip. His expression remained impassive, as if merely performing routine duties. But on one page of the jade slip, four characters were conspicuously written: Controllable Pawn. 'This Chen Ji,' the black-robed figure murmured to Ling Yuan, 'has decent talent and sufficient composure. Worth cultivating.' Ling Yuan nodded, his gaze sinister.

dialogue.content: After the selection concluded, Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in Chen Ji's mind once more: 'Well done. You've successfully drawn their attention. Now, I must tell you a secret—the true meaning of Heavenly Fate's Chosen One.' Chen Ji found a secluded corner and closed his eyes in contemplation. 'Speak.' Mo Xiansheng sighed: 'The so-called Heavenly Fate's Chosen One is merely a chess piece selected by the Heavenly Dao's grand chess game in the mortal realm. You will be sent to higher planes of battle, fighting for the will of the Heavenly Eye. And your mission is to infiltrate and find a way to destroy it.'

text.content: Chen Ji opened his eyes, his gaze profound. He recalled that during the selection, he had faintly sensed an ancient forbidden land deep within the Tianqing Sect emitting a familiar aura—an aura from the same source as the Tianji Record. Mo Xiansheng had said the Tianji Record was not the only copy; more fragments were scattered across various locations. 'If I could find other fragments in the forbidden land,' Chen Ji murmured, 'perhaps I could complete the Tianji Record. Then—' Mo Xiansheng interrupted: 'Don't be hasty. The forbidden land is not somewhere you can venture into now. But your identity as Heavenly Fate's Chosen One will grant you qualification to enter.'

dialogue.content: 'So, I need to win the title of Heavenly Fate's Chosen One.' A cold smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth. 'Since I'm merely a chess piece, let the chess players believe everything is under their control. Little do they know—' A sharp glint flashed in his eyes. 'The mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind.'

choice.prompt: The Final Championship Approaches. You Need to Decide What Strategy to Employ in the Final Match.

choices.description: Deliberately Lose in the Final, Preserving the Hollow Title of Heavenly Fate's Chosen One but Avoiding Prematurely Exposing All Strength.
choices.visible_reward: Continue to Hide One's Trump Card
choices.risk_hint: Might Be Considered by the Heavenly Eye to Have Insufficient Potential

text.content: In the final, Chen Ji 'narrowly victorious' entered the top three, ultimately ranking third. That core disciple named Zhou Tong arrogantly claimed first place, but during the award ceremony, he discovered that Ling Yuan and the black-robed figure's gazes were not on him at all—they were watching Chen Ji. Zhou Tong trembled with rage but dared not say more. The black-robed figure recorded in the jade slip: 'Third place, extremely high potential, worthy of attention—adjusted to: Key Cultivation Target.'

choices.text: Win the Championship in the Final
choices.description: Claim First Place Honorably, Let Everyone Witness the Underdog's Triumph!
choices.visible_reward: Shock the Entire Arena, Rise to Fame in One Battle
choices.risk_hint: Become the Target of All Enemies

text.content: In the final's last battle, Chen Ji faced Zhou Tong. This time, he held nothing back. Within three moves, Zhou Tong was blasted off the arena platform, utterly disheveled. Complete silence filled the venue, followed by earth-shaking cheers—the underdog's triumph! This is what true satisfaction feels like! Ling Yuan's expression turned ashen, but the black-robed figure revealed a satisfied smile: 'Excellent, very good. The rise of waste最能证明天赋，最能彰显命运。trash崛起，最能证明天道意志的公正。 Chen Ji stood on the platform, accepting the tumultuous cheers, yet his heart remained placid. His gaze swept beyond the crowd toward that forbidden land deep within the Tianqing Sect. 'Wait for me.'

choices.description: Seize the Opportunity of the Final Championship to Publicly Expose Evidence of Ling Yuan's Secret Collusion with the Demonic Path!

text.content: Just as Zhou Tong was about to be defeated, Chen Ji suddenly withdrew his hand and turned to Ling Yuan, shouting loudly: 'Sect Master Ling, there is something this disciple does not understand—three days ago, when you secretly met with that Demonic Path envoy, were you discussing cooperation?' At these words, the entire crowd erupted in commotion. Ling Yuan's face changed dramatically as he shouted sternly: 'Silence! Someone, arrest this babbling fool!' However, the black-robed figure raised his hand to stop him: 'Wait, let him finish.' Chen Ji smiled faintly and took out a recording stone from his chest—the images it contained showed precisely Ling Yuan's secret meeting with Demonic Path figures. Mo Xiansheng mentally praised: 'Good lad, this move is ruthless!'

Regardless of which strategy was chosen, Chen Ji successfully obtained the title of Heavenly Fate Son. The moment the news spread, the entire Tianqing Sect沸腾了。那个被所有人嘲笑的trash弟子，竟在短短数日内完成了defy fate？有人惊叹，有人嫉妒，更有人开始暗中调查陈机的真实来历。凌渊虽然面上不动声色，却下令加强了对陈机的监视。而那黑袍观察者，在玉简上留下了最终的评语：

"陈机，可控棋子，已入局。后续观察：待定。"

dialogue.content: Deep in the night, Chen Ji sat alone by the window. Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted forth: 'You have officially entered the Heavenly Secrets Eye's chess game. From now on, every move you make will be watched. But this is also an opportunity—only by standing on that stage can you接触真正的核心秘密。' Chen Ji望着窗外的月色，轻声道："我知道。我在意的不是成为棋子，而是成为那个掀翻棋盘的人。" Mo Xiansheng沉默片刻，sighing道："你比上一代那个家伙，有魄力得多。"

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Fate Son title is secured—what should be the next move?

choices.description: Under cover of night, infiltrate the Forbidden Grounds to search for other fragments of the Tianji Record.
choices.risk_hint: The Forbidden Grounds are heavily guarded, may alert Ling Yuan

text.content: That night, Chen Ji employed concealment techniques to infiltrate the Forbidden Grounds. What surprised him was that the guards seemed far more lax than he had anticipated—as if someone had arranged it deliberately. Deep within the Forbidden Grounds, he sensed a familiar aura that resonated with the Tianji Record. Just as he was about to reach the source of that aura, a figure suddenly appeared—'I knew you would come.' It was Su Qingyao. She held a longsword, blocking the cave entrance, her eyes filled with complex emotions: 'Chen Ji, what exactly are you hiding?'

choices.description: Since Ling Yuan has secrets, better take the initiative to gather evidence of his crimes.

text.content: Chen Ji utilized his Heavenly Fate Son status to secretly investigate Ling Yuan's past within the sect. He discovered that twenty years ago, Ling Yuan had been one of the candidates for inheriting the Tianji Record, but was ultimately surpassed by a junior named Chen Xuan. 'Chen Xuan...' Chen Ji murmured—that was his ancestor, the original holder of the Tianji Record. 'It seems Ling Yuan's hatred for you is not only because you are atrash, but also because you carry that person's bloodline.' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of lamentation.

choices.description: Proactively approach the Heavenly Secrets Eye's observer to obtain more intelligence.

text.content: Chen Ji approached the black-robed observer under the pretense of请教cultivation. The two sat facing each other in a pavilion, Chen Ji respectfully seeking guidance while the observer regarded him with an enigmatic smile. 'You are quite clever, knowing which side to stand on.' The observer said, 'But I must remind you—before Heaven, clever people often die the fastest.' Chen Ji appeared terrified on the surface while his mind raced. From this observer, he extracted some crucial information: the Heavenly Secrets Eye conducts a 'great reshuffle' every thousand years, at which time all chess pieces will be reselected. 'Once every thousand years...' Chen Ji暗道, 'Then when is the next one?'

That night, Chen Ji could not fall asleep. He stood at the highest point of the Tianqing Sect, overlooking this massive sect, his thoughts in turmoil. The Heavenly Fate Son title was both a shackle and a ladder. Ling Yuan's ambitions, the Heavenly Secrets Eye's gaze, Mo Xiansheng's secrets, Chen Nian's whereabouts... all the clues intertwined, forming a vast and dangerous chess game. And he stood at the center of the chessboard, enemies on all sides, yet opportunities on all sides as well. 'Sister, wait for me.' Chen Ji murmured softly, 'Wait for me to turn this chess game upside down, then I will come to bring you home.'

dialogue.content: At the same time, in the void above the highest peak of the Tianqing Sect, a pair of invisible eyes watched all of this. That was the本体 of the Heavenly Secrets Eye. It had no fixed form, merely an existence beyond human comprehension. But at this moment, a voice seemed to emerge from within this existence: 'Interesting... this chess piece is far more interesting than anticipated. Since that is the case, let him walk further—let us see how far he can go.' As the voice fell, an order quietly spread throughout the entire Heavenly Secrets chess game: Chen Ji, enter the priority observation list.

text.content:
In a secret realm far away at the Demonic Holy Sect, a young girl suddenly opened her eyes.

She was Chen Nian—Chen Ji's sister who had been missing for many years, imprisoned here by the Holy Sect as the "Heavenly Fate Shackles." At this moment, she sensed a familiar aura approaching, faint yet stubborn, like a sliver of light in a cold night. "Brother..." Chen Nian murmured, her eyes turning red, "Are you finally taking action?" Her fingers tightly gripped a jade pendant at her chest, on which the character "Ji" was carved.

Meanwhile, within the Tianqing Sect, Chen Ji suddenly felt an inexplicable pang in his heart. He raised his head to gaze into the distance, his gaze shifting slightly: "Chen Nian... wait for me."

The sky brightened, and a new day began.

Chen Ji packed away all his emotions, becoming once again that seemingly ordinarytrash disciple. But his eyes were more determined than yesterday. The identity of a Heavenly Fate Chosen One was already in hand, the chess game of the Heavenly Eye had begun, and next—the time to steadily turn the entire game around.

"Chen Ji." Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded for the last time, "Remember, the more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger the inevitable backlash of fate. Every step must be taken with extreme caution."

Chen Ji nodded, a smile curving his lips: "Rest assured, I never fight a battle without certainty."

In the distance, the morning bell tolled, officially beginning a new day at the Tianqing Sect. And beneath this seemingly calm surface, undercurrents were already stirring. A greater storm was about to arrive.
